summary: Christiane Antoine's working copy of the VD-15-134 FT09 indazole delivery workbook for Feldorune Therapeutics BV. It records the N-substitution map across 40 analogues, the N1/N2 assignments and isolated yields, with reviewer comments left in the cells. Kept on the leaver's old laptop, so the notes are informal and some are not yet agreed.

sheets.name: Summary
rows: Delivered. Positional assignments in the N-substitution sheet are the ones we sent. The two open ones are flagged in the comments.
CA: NOESY for the N2 set is in the folder, not yet on the LIMS. Ask CF whether it goes in the lot record.

sheets.name: N-substitution

rows.v: N-substitution: alkylation conditions and the N1/N2 split

rows: NaH, DMF, 0 C then alkyl bromide
Gives a mixture. Ratio is the thing to watch, so run both isomers through the column.
Favours N1 for the bulkier halides. Less useful for the small alkyls.
Only for the hydroxyethyl side chains. Slow but clean.
N1 vs N2 by HMBC and NOESY. Not from 1H shifts alone, the shifts overlap on the aryl ring.
Two divergent potency trends. Seems to follow the N-substituent size, which is what the study plan asked for.
